items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 August 2026 10:36pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 26 August 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure to the southwest of Britain, with associated troughs drifting northwards.


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight, decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon, becoming variable 2 to 4 during the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, occasionally moderate in places overnight & in the morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain spreading from the south tomorrow afternoon & evening, turning heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later in the period.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming west or northwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, occasionally moderate in places later.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy in places, becoming mainly fair Friday afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in places.
